technicalNotes:
This Fault will be set if the Parking Fren Motor runs for 20 Seconds while the Shut-Off Current isn't reached and the Wheel can still be turned. A possible Scenario would be operating the Parking Fren without a Fren Disc being installed/present, i.e. no End Position is being defined and may result in Damage to the Parking Fren Motor.
Make sure to cycle the Parking Fren a couple of times between checking for Fault Codes, this will ensure that the Kontrol Modülü tests the related Components again.
